meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: Claude 会把用户给的一份文档变成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF;原文缺失或太单薄时,它会先写一篇长文再生成。最后交付一个手机版分享链接,本地 PDF 作为备份。
howto.when: 当用户说“Wowerpoint 这个文件”“给某个文件做一套幻灯片”或“把这份报告转成幻灯片”等,要求把单个文档变成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 需要一份源文档;缺失或太单薄会先补写。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要变成一套幻灯片。
say.note: 会生成 PDF;分享链接取决于服务配置。
默认用可爱角色讲故事;可另给提示词。

howto.what_en: Claude turns one user-provided document into a kawaii-style slide-deck PDF; if the source is missing or too thin, it first writes a fuller long-form version. The final deliverable is a mobile share link, with the local PDF kept as backup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “Wowerpoint this file”, “make a slide deck about this file”, or “turn this report into slides”, or otherwise asks to turn a single document into shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Needs one source doc; if missing or too thin, it writes one first.

say_en.text: Turn these meeting minutes into slides.
say_en.note: Produces a PDF; share link depends on service config.
Default is a kawaii story; you can provide your own prompt.
